name: Rear arc

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Frobenius PROP in a traced symmetric monoidal category

VINIT.justification: The state before any distinction between presence and absence is articulated.

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary where the system recognizes its own limit as a closed shell.

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism that articulates unity into a tensor product of distinct states.

AREV.justification: The reverse morphism that dissolves distinction back into the monoidal unit.

CLINK.justification: The chaining of morphisms to form the round-trip cycle.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition where the system maps to itself without change.

FSPLIT.justification: The monoidal unit I splits into the tensor product I ⊗ I.

FFUSE.justification: The tensor product I ⊗ I is merged back into the monoidal unit I.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative branch where the round-trip recovers the starting state losslessly.

EVALF.justification: The negative branch representing the unprovable or undecidable region.

ENGAGR.justification: The dialetheic ground where the system is both empty and full simultaneously.

IFIX.justification: The permanent record of the braiding history, such as the Jones polynomial.

phase_3.void_description: The uninitialized Void before the first naming or distinction.
phase_3.true_description: The lossless recovery of the identity through the Frobenius round-trip.
phase_3.false_description: The divergence or incompleteness encountered during self-differentiation.
phase_3.both_description: The saturated fixed point where contradiction is admitted as stable data.

steps.domain_action: The pre-geometric Void preconditions the possibility of distinction.
The monoidal unit I recognizes itself as the starting point.
The unit I articulates into I ⊗ I, creating a distinction where there was unity.
The forward morphism propagates the differentiation toward a target state.
The affirmative branch confirms the structural fidelity of the copy.
The composition chains the differentiation to the reintegration phase.
The negative branch maps the inherent incompleteness of the articulation.
The reverse morphism begins the descent back toward the unit.
The tensor product I ⊗ I is merged, reconstituting the original unit I.
The system holds the B-state where the round-trip is both a split and a return.
The braiding history is fixed as a topologically protected link invariant.
The system reaches the terminal anchor, closing the Frobenius cycle.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Imscribing Grammar translating structural types into categorical morphisms.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Braided monoidal tensor products allowing information flow between branches.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Topological invariants (Jones polynomials) storing the history of the braiding.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Frobenius cycle (THINK-ACT-OBSERVE-UPDATE) governing the tick of the kernel.
phase_5.alfs_store: The paraconsistent Lean 4 kernel providing the machine-checkable ground.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Zero bits erased during the adiabatic expansion of the logical space.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Compressed Boolean subspace under the pressure of the principle of explosion.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Relaxed Belnap FOUR lattice at its natural resting volume.
